_causes.name: A bad result passes on silently
_causes.fix: Every stage ends on one pass or fail receipt; the next stage refuses to start without a pass.

_causes.name: Something upstream never arrived
_causes.fix: Run the hand-off check before a stage starts, not after it fails.

_causes.name: Only works on one Mac
_causes.fix: One ready check per role; steps that need this Mac move to the mini or the role is marked Mac-only.

_causes.name: A key or login is missing
_causes.fix: The same ready check tests every key the stage needs before it spends a minute.

_causes.name: A model or the network hiccups
_causes.fix: Retry, then resume from the stage that stopped, without a person.

_causes.name: The brief is never filed or numbered
_causes.fix: Number the brief once, when writing accepts it; every later stage reads that one number.

_causes.name: The hand-off folder is built two ways
_causes.fix: One builder, one folder shape, one name for what comes back.

_causes.name: No way for the holder to fix it
_causes.fix: A redo and a change door on every stage, so nobody edits a file by hand.

_causes.name: Waits on the owner
_causes.fix: Every owner call (new format, style, spend) lands in one queue with one click each.

_causes.name: Out of date after a change
_causes.fix: A changed input re-runs only the stages that read it, automatically.

_causes.name: A choice the holder makes
_causes.fix: Ask it once at the start (product, route, lane), never mid-run.

_causes.name: A real check doing its job
_causes.fix: Keep. Each says the one thing to fix. Run each check once, not in writing and again in production.
